identity.mission: Create a mythic, gritty, and immersive game hub that breaks standard 'clean' SaaS tropes.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Ancient Mythology with Cyberpunk Decay.
Emotion First: Every pixel must feel 'Epic' and 'Dangerous'.
Content is King: The Lore is the UI.
Contrast: Deepest Blacks vs Neon Elemental Bursts.

theme.vibe: Bronx-Honest Mythology. Gritty, neon-soaked, ancient power in a broken city.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Character Names. Use uppercase for maximum impact.

body.usage: Lore text, stats, UI elements. High legibility with a tech edge.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (The Tetris Grid)
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-24. Never cram content.

buttons.classes: rounded-full border border-primary/50 bg-primary/10 hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(46,46,254,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-sm

cards.classes: relative overflow-hidden bg-black/40 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl hover:border-white/20 transition-colors group

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5

inputs.classes: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-primary outline-none px-0 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.gradients: No linear gradients. Use radial blasts of color behind objects.
visual_enhancers.textures: Grain overlay (opacity 0.05) on all backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid white/10. Use 'shimmer' effects on active cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows only. No black shadows on black backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. TAILWIND CONFIG: Update theme colors to match the 'colors' section above. Add the fonts to the font family config.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add a global grain texture overlay using a pseudo-element on the body.
4. COMPONENTS: When building the 'Tail System', use the 'Tracing Beam' card style.
5. LORE: Use the 'Cinzel' font for any text related to the 'Ancient Memory' or 'Gods'.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. SHADCN: Customize all Shadcn components to remove the 'default' look. Increase border radius on dialogs, remove bg from inputs.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic purple gradients.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
